rationale: The agent located the user by name and ZIP and accessed the user’s orders, which aligns with authentication and acting on the user’s own account. However, it performed order-changing writes (cancelling two pending orders) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, it supplied the cancellation reason “ordered by mistake” without evidence that the user provided it, and stated refund details (original payment method and 5–7 business days) not supported by any tool output shown. These issues constitute acting without required confirmation and providing unsupported information, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
